headline: Suryoday SFB appoints Alok Pathak as CRO
summary: Suryoday Small Finance Bank appointed Alok Pathak as Chief Risk Officer for three years. Yogesh Dixit was redesignated as Head of Governance Projects effective October 1, 2026.

headline: Valecha Engineering concludes 49th AGM
summary: Valecha Engineering Limited held its 49th Annual General Meeting on September 30, 2026. Shareholders adopted FY26 financial statements and approved auditor appointments.

headline: Skyways Air passes all 9 AGM resolutions
summary: Skyways Air Services Ltd passed all nine resolutions at its 42nd AGM, including FY26 financials and dividend approval. Promoter group voted 100% in favour.

headline: Atul Auto invests ₹18.34 crore in Khushbu Auto Finance
summary: Atul Auto invested ₹18.34 crore in Khushbu Auto Finance through a rights issue, bringing its total investment in the subsidiary to ₹96.15 crore.

headline: KP Green Engineering CEO Alok Das resigns
summary: Dr. Alok Das resigned as Group CEO of KP Green Engineering effective October 1, 2026, citing personal reasons. The company confirmed the change in senior management via regulatory filing.

headline: Amber Enterprises gets NCLT order on subsidiary merger
summary: NCLT Chandigarh bench received no objections from tax or liquidator on AmberPR Technoplast amalgamation. Next hearing set for October 23, 2026.

headline: IndiaNivesh approves subsidiary sale at AGM
summary: IndiaNivesh shareholders approved the sale of its wholly owned subsidiary, IndiaNivesh Commodities, and re-appointed Rajesh Nuwal as MD during the 95th AGM.

headline: Arman Financial files ISIN details for NCDs
summary: Arman Financial Services submitted ISIN details for five private placement debt securities to BSE. Total issuance value stands at ₹4.07 crore across various tenors.

headline: CIAN Agro passes all AGM resolutions
summary: CIAN Agro Industries & Infrastructure Ltd shareholders approved all seven resolutions at the 39th AGM held on September 30, 2026, including auditor appointment and MD re-appointment.

headline: Emrock Corp AGM voting results
summary: Emrock Corporation Limited shareholders approved all resolutions at its 32nd AGM. Key votes included financial statements adoption and director reappointment.

headline: Acme Resources AGM voting results
summary: Acme Resources Ltd shareholders approved all five resolutions at its 41st AGM. Key approvals included statutory auditor reappointment and director continuation beyond age 75.

headline: Jeena Sikho gets NABH accreditation for Raipur unit
summary: Jeena Sikho Lifecare Ltd secured NABH accreditation for its Panchakarma services at the Raipur hospital, valid until August 2029.

headline: Sri KPR Industries appoints Basha as Chairman
summary: Sri KPR Industries Ltd appointed Amarnath Narsing Rao Basha as Chairman on October 1, 2026, following the cessation of Independent Director Naveena Thammishetty Chandra.
